title: Grateful Dead Live at Kezar Stadium on 1973-05-26
source: 7" Betty Board Reel @ 7 1/2 ips > PCM501ES (Beta HiFi) ( @ 44.055 kHz) > PCM501ES analog out > analog in Fostex D5 ( @ 48kHz) > Fostex D5 optical S/PDIF out (Jace's tape) > Sound Forge 5.0 > wav/shn

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a high‑energy 1973 three‑set show featuring a monster “The Other One” and “Eyes of the World”, though the second set drags in places.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the overall power and rock‑and‑roll feel of this 1973 performance, especially the blazing “Other One” and the soaring “Eyes of the World”. The recording is praised as a clean, well‑balanced soundboard tape, but several reviewers note that Jerry’s guitar is lazy early in the second set (Half‑Step → Truckin' → He's Gone) before snapping back. Despite those hiccups, the concert remains a favorite for its classic ’73 vibe.

ai_rating.rationale: Show quality is generally strong (≈4/5) with standout moments and only a modest dip in the second set; recording quality is praised as excellent (≈5/5). Weighted average yields ~4.3 stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers commend the clarity and balance of the tape, calling it a great recording with no noted drop‑outs or muddiness.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Three‑set marathon that rocks hard overall; first set solid, second set uneven with a weak middle before picking up again in the later jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Mixed – lazy and lackluster from Half‑Step through Truckin' and early He's Gone, then revs up to god‑like playing later in the set.
